company.shortDescription: Kry helps patients to make active choices about their health in partnership with public and private healthcare professionals.
company.description:
Kry offers digital healthcare services that help patients to make active choices about their health in partnership with public and private healthcare professionals. It specializes in the fields of healthcare, E-health, and Digital health.

Kry was founded in 2015 and headquartered in Stockholms Lan, Sweden.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series D round raised $160,000,000, or 21.94% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $31,373,885 to $2,177,660,118, a 69.41x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
